---
title: "Synteny and Orthology"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(GENESPACE)
library(ape)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtree)
library(patchwork)
library(here)
theme_set(theme_bw())
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

# Completed GENESPACE/OrthoFinder run from workflow/synteny-orthology/.
wd <- file.path(path.expand(Sys.getenv("PROJECT_DATA", "~/project_data/downy")), "results/synteny-orthology")
load(file.path(wd, "results", "gsParams.rda"))  # gsParam
orthofinder_dir <- list.dirs(file.path(wd, "orthofinder"), recursive = FALSE)
orthofinder_dir <- orthofinder_dir[grepl("/Results_", orthofinder_dir)]
stopifnot(length(orthofinder_dir) == 1, length(gsParam$genomeIDs) == 15)
stats_dir <- file.path(orthofinder_dir, "Comparative_Genomics_Statistics")

focal_assemblies <- c(
  "Peronospora_effusa_UA202013_star",
  "Pseudoperonospora_cubensis_MSU1",
  "Pseudoperonospora_cubensis_SC1982",
  "Pseudoperonospora_humuli_OR502AA"
)

# OrthoFinder statistics files hold several tables separated by blank lines; read the first.
read_first_block <- function(file, ...) {
  lines <- readLines(file)
  lines <- head(lines, match("", lines, nomatch = length(lines) + 1) - 1)
  read.delim(text = paste(lines, collapse = "\n"), check.names = FALSE, ...)
}
```

```{r orthogroup-summary}
overall <- read_first_block(file.path(stats_dir, "Statistics_Overall.tsv"), header = FALSE, col.names = c("Metric", "Value"))
knitr::kable(
  subset(overall, Metric %in% c(
    "Number of species", "Number of genes", "Number of genes in orthogroups",
    "Percentage of genes in orthogroups", "Number of orthogroups",
    "Number of orthogroups with all species present", "Number of single-copy orthogroups"
  )),
  row.names = FALSE,
  caption = "OrthoFinder orthogroups for the GENESPACE genome set."
)
```

```{r orthogroups-by-species}
per_species <- read_first_block(file.path(stats_dir, "Statistics_PerSpecies.tsv"))
rownames(per_species) <- per_species[[1]]
per_species <- per_species[-1]
knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    Genome = names(per_species),
    Genes = as.integer(per_species["Number of genes", ]),
    `Genes in orthogroups` = as.integer(per_species["Number of genes in orthogroups", ]),
    `In orthogroups (%)` = as.numeric(per_species["Percentage of genes in orthogroups", ]),
    `Unassigned genes` = as.integer(per_species["Number of unassigned genes", ]),
    `Species-specific orthogroups` = as.integer(per_species["Number of species-specific orthogroups", ]),
    check.names = FALSE
  ),
  row.names = FALSE,
  caption = "Per-genome orthogroup assignment."
)
```

```{r synteny-contigs-tree-riparian, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=6.7}
tr <- read.tree(file.path(wd, "results", "SpeciesTree_rooted.txt"))
stopifnot(setequal(tr$tip.label, gsParam$genomeIDs))
tree <- ggtree(tr)
# Rotate clades so related genomes sit beside each other in the riparian plot.
for (tips in list(
  c("Peronospora_effusa_UA202013_star", "Peronospora_effusa_UA202013", "Peronospora_destructor_Pd_K2019"),
  c("Phytophthora_sojae_JS2", "Phytophthora_infestans_1306"),
  c("Phytophthora_sojae_JS2", "Phytophthora_agathidicida_3770"),
  c("Phytophthora_plurivora_TJ71", "Phytophthora_infestans_1306")
)) tree <- ggtree::rotate(tree, getMRCA(tr, tips))

tip_data <- tree$data[tree$data$isTip, ]
tip_ids <- tip_data$label[order(tip_data$y)]
y_limits <- c(0.5, length(tip_ids) + 0.5)
display_labels <- sub("_star$", "*", tip_ids)
tip_labels <- as.expression(Map(function(id, label) {
  if (id %in% focal_assemblies) bquote(bold(.(label))) else label
}, tip_ids, display_labels))

aligned_tree <- tree +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 0, b = 10, l = 10))

riparian <- plot_riparian(
  gsParam = gsParam,
  genomeIDs = tip_ids,
  refGenome = "Peronospora_effusa_UA202013",
  chrLabFun = function(x) "",
  useRegions = TRUE,
  xlabel = "Contigs scaled by gene rank order"
)
aligned_synteny <- riparian$plotData$ggplotObj +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits, expand = c(0, 0), breaks = seq_along(tip_ids), labels = tip_labels) +
  ylab(NULL) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 0), axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"))

synteny_contigs_plot <- aligned_tree + aligned_synteny + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 4))
out <- here("figures", "synteny-contigs-tree-riparian")
ggsave(paste0(out, ".svg"), synteny_contigs_plot, device = svglite::svglite, width = 180, height = 170, units = "mm")
ggsave(paste0(out, ".pdf"), synteny_contigs_plot, device = grDevices::pdf, width = 180, height = 170, units = "mm", family = "Helvetica", useDingbats = FALSE)
ggsave(paste0(out, ".tiff"), synteny_contigs_plot, device = ragg::agg_tiff, width = 180, height = 170, units = "mm", dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
ggsave(paste0(out, ".png"), synteny_contigs_plot, device = ragg::agg_png, width = 180, height = 170, units = "mm", dpi = 600)
synteny_contigs_plot
```
